description: Per-character action index that binds a character to its movement sub-tables and selects the AttackSet row for each normal, cursed-energy, super and extra attack action.

Id.simple: Character ID used as the row key.
Id.technical: Unreal DataTable row name (exported as ID). CharacterDataTable.Id_Action selects it through ResolveDataRows, with StudioBattleCharacterOverrides.ActionIdOverride taking priority; the row is required. GameCommandListWidget also resolves it directly from the character row.

Id_ActionMove.technical: FName into ActionMoveDataTables. ResolveDataRows requires this row and stores it as AGameCharacter.ActionMoveRow; shikigami setup resolves its own ActionMove row when the shikigami row provides an id. No studio override is applied here.

Id_ActionJump.technical: FName into ActionJumpDataTables; required by ResolveDataRows. Shikigami setup resolves its own jump row when the shikigami row supplies an id.

Id_ActionDash.technical: FName into ActionDashDataTables. StudioBattleCharacterOverrides.ActionDashIdOverride (including the PvE settings copy) supersedes it; ResolveDataRows fails if neither resolves a row.

Id_ActionStep.technical: FName into ActionStepDataTables. StudioBattleCharacterOverrides.ActionStepIdOverride, also copied by PvE settings, takes priority over this row value.

Id_ActionBreakFall.technical: FName into ActionBreakFallDataTables; required by ResolveDataRows. No override path was observed for this id.

Id_AttackSet_Normal_1.technical: FName AttackSetDataTables key. The corresponding action class passes it to Action_FindAttackSetRow(..., bCheckNone=true) from GetAttackSetRow; the resolved AttackSet supplies the actual per-hit Attack rows. Also the default for generic FGameCharacterAction_AttackBase::GetAttackSetRow.

Id_AttackSet_CursedEnergy_1.simple: first cursed-energy attack set by level
Id_AttackSet_CursedEnergy_1.technical: TArray<FName> with four entries in the export. Cursed-energy actions use index = CursedEnergyLevel - 1, or 3 when IsFinishTarget is true, check IsValidIndex, then look up that entry in AttackSetDataTables; None/invalid yields no set. Auto variants use the auto-combo damage rate; Air variants are for airborne actions.

Id_AttackSet_SuperCursedEnergy.technical: FName into AttackSetDataTables. The SuperCursedEnergyAttack action resolves it in GetAttackSetRow; character controllers and AI conditions also read it directly, including an IsNone test that gates super-attack AI behavior.

Id_AttackSet_SuperCursedEnergy_Air.technical: FName into AttackSetDataTables used by the SuperCursedEnergyAttackAir action class. The export has no solo/level-index variant for this slot.

Id_ExtraAttack_1.technical: FName into AttackSetDataTables resolved by character-specific ExtraAttack_1 action classes (CN_041/CN_122/CN_230/CN_250/CP_020/CP_051/CP_070/CP_110/CP_170/CP_200 and others). None yields no set from the finder.

Id_ExtraAttack_2.technical: FName into AttackSetDataTables resolved only by characters with a second extra attack (examples CN_230, CP_020, CP_050). None yields no set.

notes: One exported table with 57 rows; no numbered shards or localization variants for this group.
Auto suffixed ids belong to auto-combo action classes, which override GetActionDamageRate with the owner auto-combo rate.
Solo suffixed ids are chosen by UnknownSlot146(): solo side, no other active same-team attacker, or a positive Adapt_TagCombo buff.
Cursed-energy arrays are indexed by cursed-energy level (1..4), with index 3 forced for a finish target; exported arrays have four entries and may contain None.
None ids are passed to Action_FindAttackSetRow with bCheckNone=true, which treats None as no row. Not every character supplies every extra/super attack.
Evidence is reconstructed C++; no retail byte-match claim is made. Available Content is partial, so unobserved Blueprint or retail uses are not excluded.

usages.detail: Resolves the Action row from CharacterDataTable.Id_Action (or its override), then resolves the five movement sub-row ids.
Generic attack base uses Id_AttackSet_Normal_1 when no specialized action overrides it.
Auto-combo normal attack actions select their _Auto attack set ids.
1_1 normal follow-up actions choose the solo or non-solo attack set via UnknownSlot146().
Cursed-energy actions index their four-entry arrays by level or finish-target index.
Super attack actions resolve the grounded and airborne super attack set ids.
Character-specific extra attack action resolves Id_ExtraAttack_1.
Character-specific extra attack action resolves Id_ExtraAttack_2.
Command-list setup reads the Action row directly for the selected character.
